photoshopWorkflows.title: E-Commerce Pure White Background & Product Pop
photoshopWorkflows.originalPrompt: Create a Photoshop action that automatically removes the background, improves product brightness, adds contrast, sharpens the product, creates a white background and exports a 2000x2000 JPG.
photoshopWorkflows.objective: Transform raw camera product photos into Amazon/Flipkart compliant 2000x2000px pure white RGB (255,255,255) images with calibrated curves, contrast, and unsharp masking.
photoshopWorkflows.description: Fully automated e-commerce product enhancement action pipeline featuring AI subject selection, white canvas backing, tonal curves, and high-clarity output.
photoshopWorkflows.confidenceReason: Standard Photoshop selection, adjustment layers, unsharp mask, and export dimensions are 100% action-recordable.
actionLimitations: Subject selection works best with high-contrast edges against studio backdrops.
Semi-transparent objects (glass/perfume) may benefit from manual mask touch-ups.

steps.title: Open Document & Duplicate Base Layer
steps.explanation: Preserves the non-destructive original base photograph before applying extractions.
steps.expectedResult: Unlocked working layer named "Product Layer" above Background.

steps.title: Execute AI Select Subject
steps.recommendedValue: Select > Subject (Device: Cloud for crispest edge detection)
steps.explanation: Uses Adobe Sensei AI to automatically compute precise bounding selection around the main product.
steps.expectedResult: Active marching ants selection wrapping the product contours.

steps.title: Apply Layer Mask from Selection
steps.recommendedValue: Feather 0.3px to eliminate harsh pixelated cutouts
steps.explanation: Isolates the product subject from the raw background with soft sub-pixel antialiasing.

steps.title: Insert Pure White RGB 255 Solid Fill Background
steps.menuPath: Layer > New Fill Layer > Solid Color...
steps.explanation: Ensures strict compliance with Amazon & Flipkart 100% pure white main listing image regulations.
steps.expectedResult: A solid clean white layer placed directly beneath the isolated product layer.

steps.title: Apply Tonal Brightness & Contrast Adjustment
steps.explanation: Eliminates camera sensor underexposure and pops product highlights.
steps.expectedResult: Vibrant, clear product visibility across all monitors.

steps.title: Apply Unsharp Mask Sharpening Filter
steps.explanation: Brings out crisp micro-textures, stitching, and product branding details for marketplace zoom preview.
steps.expectedResult: Razor-sharp product edges without halo noise.

steps.title: Fit Image to 2000x2000 Square Canvas
steps.settings: Width: 2000 px, Height: 2000 px, Anchor: Center, Canvas extension color: White
steps.explanation: Centers product and scales canvas to ideal high-resolution Amazon zoom-ready proportions.

steps.title: Export Optimized E-Commerce JPG
steps.menuPath: File > Export > Export As... (or Save for Web Legacy)
steps.settings: Format: JPEG, Quality: 90% (High), Color Space: Convert to sRGB, Embed Color Profile: True
steps.explanation: Produces web-compressed JPEG file ready for instant seller portal upload.

qualityChecks: Verify background is true RGB (255, 255, 255) using Info panel Eyedropper.
Check edges for fuzzy fringe or background bleed.
Confirm image dimensions are exactly 2000 x 2000 px at 300 DPI.
Ensure file size is within marketplace upload limits (typically < 10MB).

photoshopWorkflows.title: High-End Portrait Skin Retouching & Frequency Separation
photoshopWorkflows.originalPrompt: Create a portrait skin-retouching workflow with frequency separation, natural texture preservation, and gentle eye pop.
photoshopWorkflows.objective: Professional portrait beauty retouching that divides image into High Frequency (Texture/Pores) and Low Frequency (Color/Tone) layers for pristine studio finish.
photoshopWorkflows.description: Hybrid studio action and manual guide for magazine-grade skin smoothing without artificial plastic look.
photoshopWorkflows.confidenceReason: Layer creation, Gaussian blur, Apply Image calculations are automated; delicate spot healing requires manual brush strokes on High Frequency layer.
actionLimitations: Healing brush and clone stamp operations require manual artist discretion based on model facial geometry.
Dodge and burn intensity should be adapted according to studio key lighting.

steps.title: Create Low Frequency (Color) Layer
steps.explanation: Isolates the smooth skin color tones and transition gradients.

steps.title: Apply Gaussian Blur to Color Layer
steps.settings: Radius: 6.0 px (Adjust until skin texture just disappears)
steps.explanation: Blurs skin texture while leaving broad tone and shadow gradients intact.

steps.title: Create High Frequency (Texture) Layer
steps.explanation: Extracts only micro-details such as skin pores, eyelashes, and fine hairs.

steps.title: Execute Apply Image Formula (8-Bit Mode)
steps.settings: Layer: "Low Frequency - Color", Blending: Subtract, Scale: 2, Offset: 128
steps.explanation: Mathematically subtracts blurred color layer from sharp image, isolating pure 50% gray high-frequency relief.

steps.title: Set High Frequency Layer Blending Mode to Linear Light
steps.explanation: Fuses high and low frequencies back together with 100% mathematical fidelity to original portrait.
steps.expectedResult: Image appears completely normal and unchanged.

steps.title: Clean Blemishes on High Frequency Texture Layer
steps.action: Manual Clone Stamp / Spot Healing Brush
steps.menuPath: Tools > Clone Stamp Tool (S) or Spot Healing Brush (J)
steps.settings: Sample: Current Layer only, Hardness: 0%, Size: Match blemish
steps.explanation: Allows erasing pimples and blemishes without altering underlying skin tones or creating muddy patches.
steps.expectedResult: Smooth flawless skin texture with natural pores.

steps.title: Smooth Tone Transitions on Low Frequency Layer
steps.menuPath: Tools > Lasso Tool (Feather: 25px) -> Filter > Gaussian Blur
steps.settings: Lasso Feather: 20-30 px, Blur Radius: 15-25 px
steps.explanation: Evens out blotchy makeup or redness without destroying surface texture.

steps.title: Subtle Eye & Catchlight Dodge
steps.settings: Lift midtones curve slightly, invert mask (Ctrl+I), paint over irises with soft white brush (Opacity: 25%)
steps.explanation: Adds sparkle and depth to eyes without looking synthetic.

steps.title: Global Color Grading Tone Curve
steps.menuPath: Layer > New Adjustment Layer > Color Balance...
steps.settings: Highlights: +3 Yellow, Midtones: +2 Magenta, Shadows: +2 Cyan/Blue
steps.explanation: Gives the portrait a warm, flattering magazine editorial tone.

steps.title: Export High-Resolution Master Portrait
steps.explanation: Outputs pristine portrait ready for print or portfolio display.

manualSteps: Sample skin texture on High Frequency layer using Clone Stamp (Current Layer).
Smooth tone blotches on Low Frequency layer with feathered Lasso + Gaussian blur.
Paint eye catchlights with soft low-opacity brush on Dodge Curves mask.
qualityChecks: Zoom to 100% and ensure pores are preserved rather than blurred into plastic.
Check eye white tones are realistic and not over-bleached.
Confirm no color banding or halo rings around high-contrast facial edges.
